name: Fab Vanilla
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, VEGETABLE OIL (PALM OIL), CHOCO CHIPS (12%) [SUGAR, FULLY HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FAT (PALM KERNEL OIL), COCOA R(SOYA LECITHIN) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING], GLUCOSE-FRUCTOSE SYRUP, COCOA SOLIDS (1.5%), COLOUR (CARAMEL), SOLIDS, EMULSIFIE RAISING AGENTS AMMONIUM BICARBONATE, SODIUM BICARBONATE ], SALT, ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURINGS AND EMULSIFIERS (SOYA LECITHIN, STERS OF MONO AND DI-GLYCERIDES).
